dialogues.speaker: Farzaneh
dialogues.text: Is this a dream...? Or am I seasick again... I should still be standing on dry land, right?

dialogues.speaker: Farzaneh
dialogues.text: This is truly... The most wondrous festival I have ever experienced.

dialogues.speaker: Farzaneh
dialogues.text: If I am to be so happy I get dizzy, I think I could get used to that kind of dizziness...
